BiblicalUsage: Acharan is the Aramaic word for other, another one, a different one. In Daniel 2:11 the Chaldeans say there is none other who can show the king's dream except the gods, and in Daniel 2:44 God sets up a kingdom that shall not be left to other people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the God of heaven is the only other who matters, and His kingdom is the one no other people will take.
